dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Konda Village has a large dye field that is presently in need of re-cultivation, and we are short of manpower to accomplish this task. As such, I'd like to ask for some help from some youngsters from the city."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Our village is far from rich, but as long as you're willing to work, I, Konda Densuke, promise that you will be well compensated!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Those of you with families can bring them here to Konda Village. Food and board will be provided by us, all the better to make the village thrive more!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Chief, wouldn't it be better just to do some paid tourism or something rather than make advertisements like this one?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Oh, shut it with your crazy ideas! We're not taking anyone's Mora!"
